text: HDOKI JOBS is a complete job search listing website that helps employers post jobs and candidates create resumes for free.
The funding for the HDOKI JOBS project was canceled by the project creator on September 14, 2021.
The funding period for the HDOKI JOBS project was from September 1, 2021, to October 1, 2021.
HDOKI is a Montreal-based creative production company.
HDOKI provides a wide range of services in the areas of entertainment, management, web and mobile technology, Search Engine Marketing, FinTech, and blockchain technology.
HDOKI created HDOKI-JOBS.COM, an advanced e-recruitment SaaS.
HDOKI JOBS includes outstanding modules for e-recruitment.
HDOKI offers a job platform with a free real-time audio and video solution.
HDOKI provides monthly subscription packs for recruiters.
The 'Start-Up' subscription pack costs $50.00 per month and includes 10 job postings, 10 job alerts, 'Featured Company', and 'Premium Support 24/7'.
The 'Premium' subscription pack costs $120.00 per month and includes unlimited job postings and alerts, 'Featured Company', and 'Premium Support 24/7'.
The 'Discovery' subscription pack costs $10.00 per month and includes 2 job postings, 1 job alert, 'Featured Company', and 'Premium Support 24/7'.
The platform features a complete analytics module.
The platform includes a free video meeting solution.
